candidates.description: This vector is related to words containing the root or spelling pattern for prominence, precedence, and frequency.
This feature vector activates strongly on tokens containing the letter sequence "ul".
This vector activates for anatomical body parts, medical terms, and anatomical roots or prefixes.
This feature vector activates strongly on tokens containing the phonetic sequence "ang" or similar variations across different words and languages.
This vector represents biological and scientific terminology related to genetics, anatomy, and taxonomy.

This feature vector represents prefixes, roots, and terms associated with property, ownership, and proper attributes.
